description: The single authoritative tuning surface for OpenAxolotl (REQ-025). Every balance value the game uses lives here, never as a constant in system code. Each entry carries a documented name, unit and permitted range; the loader validates against that range and refuses a file that violates it rather than substituting a default.
worldOverridableRationale: A closed set, enumerated here so the Level Contract can reference this list rather than keeping a second one that drifts. Per-world difficulty and restoration economy are legitimately a world's business. Movement, capability, camera and enemy tuning stay global so the game stays coherent across forks.

controller.transition.momentum_retention.description: Fraction of speed magnitude retained when crossing a water/land boundary. Applied to magnitude, not the vector, so a surfacing swimmer keeps speed without keeping an underwater heading.

controller.swim.base_speed_m_per_s.description: Base swim speed under full 3D directional steering, before capability modifiers and the bubble boost multiplier.

controller.waddle.base_speed_m_per_s.description: Base grounded waddle speed. Deliberately well below the swim speed: water is the fast grammar, and that gap is what makes the two read as distinct rather than as one speed with a different animation.

controller.dive.speed_m_per_s.description: Descent rate of a deliberate dive. A dive sets the vertical component outright rather than adding to steering, so diving from a standstill still descends.

controller.bubble_boost.duration_s.description: How long a bubble boost multiplies swim speed. Scaled down by capability.gill_loss.boost_duration_multiplier while a gill is lost.

controller.bubble_boost.cooldown_s.description: Recovery window after a bubble boost ends, during which it cannot be re-activated. The minimum is deliberately above zero: REQ-001 AC-2 requires the boost to be GOVERNED by a cooldown, so a tuning file that zeroes it must fail to load rather than quietly producing an ungoverned boost.

controller.bubble_boost.speed_multiplier.description: Swim speed multiplier while a bubble boost is active.

controller.hop.impulse_m_per_s.description: Upward velocity a hop imparts. Only available while grounded, so a hop cannot be chained in mid-air.

controller.gravity.land_m_per_s2.description: Downward acceleration applied by the scene-tree body while the land grammar is active and the axolotl is neither climbing nor grappling. Higher than real gravity on purpose: a platformer hop that follows a 9.81 arc reads as floaty, and the hop impulse is tuned against this number rather than against physics.

controller.gravity.water_m_per_s2.description: Downward drift while swimming. 0.0 is neutral buoyancy, which is the intended feel: an axolotl holds its depth and the vertical axis belongs entirely to steering. Raise it to make water sink the player when they stop steering.

controller.gravity.terminal_speed_m_per_.description: Maximum downward speed gravity may accumulate. Bounds a long fall so a pit plunge stays readable and cannot tunnel through thin floor collision.

controller.climb.speed_m_per_s.description: Movement speed while attached to a climbable surface. Deliberately NOT scaled by leg loss: a lost leg lowers how high the axolotl can reach, not how fast it climbs.

controller.climb.max_height_m.description: How far the axolotl can rise on a single climbable surface, measured from where it attached. Multiplied by capability.leg_loss.climb_height_multiplier, which is what makes REQ-002's 'leg reduces climb height' a measurable number rather than a claim. At the ceiling the climber can still move sideways and descend.

controller.grapple.max_range_m.description: Maximum tongue-grapple anchor distance. Tested inclusively: an anchor exactly at this range attaches, one beyond it is rejected.

controller.grapple.pull_speed_m_per_s.description: Speed at which an attached grapple pulls the axolotl toward its anchor. Faster than swimming, so the grapple reads as a traversal shortcut rather than a slow winch.

controller.grapple.arrival_radius_m.description: Distance at which an attached grapple counts as arrived and detaches. Without a radius the pull would oscillate around the anchor forever.

controller.dash.max_charges.description: Water-powered dash charges held at once. The dash is usable in both grammars but recharges only in water.

controller.dash.recharge_seconds_per_cha.description: Time submerged to regain one dash charge. Does not accrue on land.

capability.tail_loss.swim_speed_multipli.description: Swim speed while the tail is lost. Capability loss degrades traversal; it never ends a run on its own. The minimum is above zero on purpose: REQ-002 AC-3 rests on a product of strictly positive factors, so every capability lost still leaves the axolotl able to move.

capability.gill_loss.boost_duration_mult.description: Bubble-boost duration while a gill is lost.

capability.leg_loss.climb_height_multipl.description: Reachable climb height while a leg is lost. Multiplies controller.climb.max_height_m.

regen.mutation.duration_s.description: How long a mutated regrowth loadout persists before reverting to the baseline form.

progression.default_lives_per_attempt.description: Lives granted at the start of an attempt. Lives are spent only on catastrophic events, never on ordinary capability loss.

progression.max_retry_seconds.description: Upper bound from losing a life to being playable again at the last checkpoint.

gillmod.bubble.duration_s.description: Active duration of the Bubble Gill mod.

gillmod.bubble.cooldown_s.description: Cooldown after the Bubble Gill mod deactivates.

gillmod.jet.duration_s.description: Active duration of the Jet Gill mod, the counter to Netbot entanglement.

gillmod.jet.cooldown_s.description: Cooldown after the Jet Gill mod deactivates.

gillmod.glow.duration_s.description: Active duration of the Glow Gill mod, which reveals Hookline Rig lines in murk.

gillmod.glow.cooldown_s.description: Cooldown after the Glow Gill mod deactivates.

enemy.hookline.mod_strip_seconds.description: Window for which a Hookline Rig snag strips the equipped Gill Mod.

enemy.runoff.vision_debuff_factor.description: Vision range multiplier while inside a Runoff Drone toxin volume.

enemy.runoff.gill_recharge_multiplier.description: Gill recharge rate multiplier while inside a Runoff Drone toxin volume.

enemy.runoff.duration_s.description: How long the Runoff Drone debuff persists after leaving the toxin volume.

enemy.netbot.swim_speed_multiplier.description: Swim speed while entangled in a Netbot ghost net.

enemy.netbot.entangle_seconds.description: Entanglement duration if the player does not counter with Jet Gills.

camera.smoothing.max_position_delta_m_pe.description: Hard per-frame clamp on camera position change, including across a grammar transition. A clamp rather than a lerp factor, so the bound holds at any frame rate.

camera.smoothing.max_rotation_delta_deg_.description: Hard per-frame clamp on camera rotation change, including across a grammar transition.

camera.smoothing.position_damping_per_se.description: Exponential damping rate for the camera's follow distance. Applied as 1-exp(-rate*delta) so the tuned number means the same thing at any frame rate. The per-frame clamp above is a separate, harder bound; this only sets how briskly the camera converges within it.

camera.smoothing.rotation_damping_per_se.description: Exponential damping rate for camera pitch and yaw. Slightly brisker than position: a camera that lags in angle reads as unresponsive faster than one that lags in distance.

camera.follow.water_distance_m.description: Follow distance in the water grammar. Further back than land so the axolotl can pitch and roll in full 3D without the camera chasing every reorientation.

camera.follow.land_distance_m.description: Follow distance in the land grammar. Closer than water, which reads as a conventional third-person follow. The gap between the two is what the grammar transition interpolates across, and therefore what the per-frame clamp is measured on.

camera.follow.water_pitch_deg.description: Camera pitch above the axolotl in the water grammar. Near level, because underwater the interesting space is ahead rather than below.

camera.follow.land_pitch_deg.description: Camera pitch above the axolotl in the land grammar. Higher than water so ledges and hop targets read against the ground.

camera.follow.min_distance_m.description: Floor on how far collision avoidance may pull the camera in. Below this the camera would be inside the axolotl; when geometry demands closer than this, the floor wins and the camera clips rather than turning the view inside out.

camera.collision.margin_m.description: How far short of contact geometry the camera stops. The minimum is deliberately above zero: REQ-005 AC-2 requires the camera to NEVER clip into geometry, and a zero margin puts it exactly on the surface where the near plane makes clipping a floating-point coin flip.

restoration.resourced.resource_cost.description: Restoration resources consumed to advance a region from barren to resourced.

restoration.restored.resource_cost.description: Restoration resources consumed to advance a region from resourced to restored.
